title: Warm German Breakfast Bowl
description: A delicious Mexican-inspired warm breakfast bowl with crispy tortilla strips and ikura on top.
instructions: Bake the crispy tortilla strips for 5-7 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
Cook the German-style breakfast sausage in a pan over medium heat, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Cook the Mexican-style breakfast bowl mixture according to package instructions.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of the cooked breakfast mixture in the bottom of a bowl.
Add a few pieces of the cooked sausage on top of the breakfast mixture.
Add a few pieces of crispy tortilla strips on top of the sausage.
Add a spoonful of ikura on top of the tortilla strips.
Garnish with sliced radishes, diced tomatoes, and sliced scallions.
